support.text:
Facts:
Elif Celik (hereinafter the Debtor) filed for bankruptcy on 6th of April, 2024. The property of Elif Celik includes an external hard drive with 4TB storage and biometric encryption appraised at $325.00, a reclining leather armchair with built-in cup holder and USB charging port valued at $645.00, and a cactus gray 2021 Ford Bronco Badlands off-roader with a fair market value of $47,950.00. Legal documents confirm that the Debtor owns a white gold tennis bracelet with alternating sapphire and diamond stones appraised at $2,185.00.
